title: Blanchard: "Boy, did we screw up"
place_text: Roswell Army Air Field, New Mexico

tellings.quote: And all Blanchard would do was laugh and said, "Boy, did we screw up?"

plain: After the 1947 events at Roswell Army Air Field in New Mexico, where the military at first announced it had recovered a crashed "flying disc" and then changed its story, a colonel there named Blanchard is said to have only laughed when asked about it and said, "Boy, did we screw up." The scientist John Brandenburg tells this to Michels as something he heard from veterans of the Roswell base. If true, it would mean a senior officer admitted in private that the base's handling of the affair had gone wrong.
